__comment: Stillbloom Basin (Phase 5d.6) — the bible's rarest, safest biome. An open field of giant glowing Stillblooms with a bright, soft, floral palette (the brightest biome, but pale and gentle, not solar). Calm reflective water ponds (the terrain's natural sea-level pools — NOT glowing Lumenwater, to stay distinct from the Moonmire), dense Moonblossom + Glow Fern. The safe-haven rule (greatly reduced hostiles) is honored by leaving monster spawns empty; when mobs land in Phase 6 this biome keeps them suppressed. Rare: placed at a hot+driest climate corner few points reach. Smooth-moonstone outcrops are a deferred refinement (Phase 9).
